goal: Prevent the next standalone BGE-M3 adapter/student attempt from being selected on the same MIRACL Arabic diagnostic queries used for the final smoke decision.

current_best_system_reference.method: BGE-M3 hybrid r100 plus BGE-reranker-v2-m3 min-max score blend
current_best_system_reference.claim_scope: retrieval-system teacher/reference, not standalone embedding model SOTA

fresh_research_2026_06_05.finding: BGE-M3 is explicitly multi-function: dense retrieval, sparse lexical matching, and multi-vector/ColBERT retrieval. The card recommends hybrid retrieval plus re-ranking for stronger retrieval pipelines.
fresh_research_2026_06_05.implication: A standalone student must be validated on BGE-M3's hybrid fusion surfaces, not only on dense-only or weak sparse-heavy ablations.

fresh_research_2026_06_05.finding: The official fine-tuning schema supports pos_scores/neg_scores for knowledge distillation, m3_kd_loss, unified_finetuning, use_self_distill, and fix_encoder controls for BGE-M3.
fresh_research_2026_06_05.implication: The existing official no-DDP M3 path is aligned with the intended teacher-score training surface; the missing piece is a stricter validation loop, not another unchecked parameter sweep.

fresh_research_2026_06_05.finding: The paper highlights self-knowledge distillation from different retrieval functionalities and efficient large-batch training as core technical ingredients behind BGE-M3 performance.
fresh_research_2026_06_05.implication: Tiny single-split smokes should not be over-interpreted; any scalable student attempt must preserve multi-mode signals and require robust held-out evidence.

fresh_research_2026_06_05.finding: MIRACL Arabic has 2,061,414 passages, 3,495 train queries, and 2,896 dev queries with 29,197 dev judgments.
fresh_research_2026_06_05.implication: MIRACL Arabic is a serious benchmark, but dev-set student selection still needs query-disjoint tune and held-out gates before any full-dev or public claim.

implemented_changes.change: Added --query-id-file, --query-offset, and --query-stride so the fixed MIRACL Arabic candidate-pool diagnostic can be split into deterministic query-disjoint tune and held-out subsets. Summary JSON now records selected query ids and split parameters.

Added a strict tune-plus-heldout gate that combines two weight-sweep summaries. It requires tune and held-out best-vs-best deltas, model-card deltas, and held-out performance of the tune-selected same-weight surface to all clear the required threshold.
Added coverage for deterministic query splitting, query-id files, and missing query-id rejection.
Added coverage proving tune-only gains are rejected when held-out criteria fail.

must_pass: held-out delta for the same-weight surface selected on tune >= +0.005

recommended_next_gpu_experiment_after_th.name: v71a validation-aware LoRA smoke
recommended_next_gpu_experiment_after_th.allowed_only_after: this gate plumbing is committed and synced to the remote L20
recommended_next_gpu_experiment_after_th.candidate_recipe: Try a materially different adapter surface from v70a, such as attention_qkv rank16 or all_linear rank8 with stronger dropout/regularization, trained on v69 blended teacher rows, then evaluate both tune and held-out query splits with scripts/check_student_diagnostic_gate.py.
recommended_next_gpu_experiment_after_th.why_not_scale_v70a: v70a improved sparse-heavy by +0.006257 but regressed best-vs-best by -0.000787, so it only repaired a weaker ablation surface and did not move the strongest frozen BGE-M3 fusion surface.

decision.next_action: Sync the new gate scripts to the remote L20 and run only a small v71a adapter smoke if it uses tune and held-out diagnostics; do not accept a tune-only gain.
